scope.region: 48 contiguous States and the District of Columbia
scope.note: One path only: federal maximum monthly allotment, household of 2, 48 States and D.C.

authority.citation: Food and Nutrition Act of 2008, 7 U.S.C. 2012(u)(2)(B) and (u)(3)(C); 7 U.S.C. 2017(a)
authority.what_it_establishes: The statute sets how the maximum allotment is derived: a 2-person household receives 55 percent of the maximum 4-person allotment, the thrifty food plan cost is adjusted each October 1, and the allotment is that cost reduced by 30 percent of household income, rounded down. The statute does not state any dollar figure. The dollar figures below are USDA's, taken from the documents cited for each value.

quotes.text: on October 1, 2025, and on each October 1 thereafter, adjust the cost of the thrifty food plan to reflect changes in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers
shall be equal to the cost to such households of the thrifty food plan reduced by an amount equal to 30 per centum of the household's income

material_facts.household_size: Number of people in the SNAP household. Must equal the rulebook's scope (2).
material_facts.monthly_net_income: Household net monthly income in USD. The maximum allotment is the benefit only when this is 0.

closure_no_income.requires_text: nobody in the household has any income
closure_no_income.description: If the case file states that nobody in the household has any income, monthly net income is 0.
